Class DefaultAsyncOverRawHttpClient

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.DefaultAsyncOverRawHttpClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AsyncRawHttpClient, Closeable, AutoCloseable
@Internal public final class DefaultAsyncOverRawHttpClient extends Object implements AsyncRawHttpClient
Default AsyncRawHttpClient implementation that adapts a RawHttpClient. Cancelling the future of an exchange cancels the subscription to the publisher of the RawHttpClient exchange.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

  • Method Details

    • exchange

      public CompletionStage<HttpResponse<?>> exchange(HttpRequest<?> request, @Nullable CloseableByteBody requestBody)
      Description copied from interface: AsyncRawHttpClient
      Send a raw request, see RawHttpClient.exchange(HttpRequest, CloseableByteBody, Thread).
      Specified by:
      exchange in interface AsyncRawHttpClient
      Parameters:
      request - The request metadata (method, URI, headers). The body of this object is ignored
      requestBody - The request body bytes. null is equivalent to an empty body. The ownership of the body immediately transfers to the client, i.e. the client will always call CloseableByteBody.close() on the body even if there is an error before the request is sent
      Returns:
      A CompletableFuture that completes with the response to this request. This response will usually be a ByteBodyHttpResponse, unless a filter replaced it

    • exchange

      public CompletionStage<HttpResponse<?>> exchange(HttpRequest<?> request, @Nullable CloseableByteBody requestBody, RawRequestOptions options)
      Description copied from interface: AsyncRawHttpClient
      Send a raw request with the given per-exchange options, see RawHttpClient.exchange(HttpRequest, CloseableByteBody, Thread, RawRequestOptions).
      Specified by:
      exchange in interface AsyncRawHttpClient
      Parameters:
      request - The request metadata (method, URI, headers). The body of this object is ignored, and the request is not modified
      requestBody - The request body bytes. null is equivalent to an empty body. The ownership of the body immediately transfers to the client, like for AsyncRawHttpClient.exchange(HttpRequest, CloseableByteBody)
      options - The options for this exchange
      Returns:
      A CompletableFuture that completes with the response to this request. A response that carries body bytes is a MutableByteBodyHttpResponse, so that it can be changed before it is relayed
